hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars, including a large white van, block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the road.

hazards.name: Lack of Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crossings or pedestrian refuges visible, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of traffic unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A continuous line of parked vehicles along the curb blocks sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line in the foreground and midground

hazards.name: Sidewalk Encroachment
hazards.description: Building stoops and stairs encroach onto the narrow sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the building frontage on the left side of the image

hazards.name: Absence of lane markings
hazards.description: The lack of painted lane lines can lead to unpredictable vehicle paths and potentially higher speeds due to the wide open asphalt.

hazards.name: Lack of Mid-block Crossing
hazards.description: Despite active commercial storefronts, there is no marked crossing, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Implement bulb-outs at crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street trees and landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the sidewalk and the roadway while narrowing the perceived street width.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings to organize traffic flow and potentially narrow the perceived travel lanes to slow vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Street Trees and Vegetation
interventions.description: Install street trees or planters to provide a physical and psychological buffer between the wide sidewalk and the roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
